title: Hall Breakfast Wraps
subtitle: Soft flour wraps rolled with eggs, turkey sausage, and spinach.
description: Flour wraps with scrambled eggs, turkey sausage, spinach, and cheese — lighter than a burrito but still handheld and line-friendly.

steps.title: Cook the components
steps.instruction: Brown turkey sausage and drain. Wilt spinach in the same pan, squeeze dry in a towel. Soft-scramble eggs over low heat—they should still look glossy when done.

steps.title: Warm tortillas
steps.instruction: Heat tortillas in a dry skillet or wrapped in foil at 300°F until pliable. Stiff tortillas tear when rolled tight.

steps.title: Build each wrap
steps.instruction: Spread a thin line of salsa verde on each tortilla. Layer eggs, sausage, spinach, feta, and optional avocado off-center. Roll tight, tucking sides as you go.

steps.title: Cut and wrap
steps.instruction: Cut each wrap in half on the bias with a sharp knife. Wrap halves in foil for grab-and-go or arrange cut-side up on a tray for dine-in.

steps.title: Hold and serve
steps.instruction: Hold wrapped portions in a 200°F oven up to 20 minutes. Serve with extra salsa and hot sauce at the line for self-serve heat.

stationWorkflow: Squeeze spinach thoroughly—wet greens turn wraps soggy within minutes on the holding rack.
Roll on a flat cutting board with tortillas oriented like a burrito, not a fajita fold.
Cut with a serrated knife using a gentle saw motion so fillings don't get pushed out the ends.
cleanupNotes: Rinse the spinach skillet while warm to prevent green film from baking onto stainless.
Collect foil wrappers in a dedicated bin during service so cleanup doesn't scatter across the hall.
leftovers: Reheat foil-wrapped halves at 325°F for 12 minutes—open foil last 3 minutes to refresh the tortilla.
Chop leftover wraps into a scramble with extra eggs and hot sauce for a second-pass skillet.

adaptable.note: Confirm corn tortillas are used, or substitute a certified gluten-free wrap.
